name: 台北公車動態
subtitle: 公車在哪、多久到，打開就知道
description:
公車到哪了，下一班還要多久？打開地圖就能看。

台北公車動態把公車、捷運、YouBike 與步行接在一起。找附近站牌、看官方到站時間，或輸入目的地比較整趟行程，不必分別切換交通方式。

【在 3D 地圖上，看車往哪裡走】
點選車牌，查看公車位置與行駛方向。拉遠地圖看全城車流，放大後跟著一輛車走。捷運列車依官方進站資料推估位置，高架與地下路段分層呈現。

【先比較，再出發】
一起比較公車、捷運與 YouBike 接駁。總時間納入走路、候車、搭車與借還車，旁邊列出預計抵達時刻；想少走路或少轉乘，也能設定個人偏好。點開步驟先看行程，按下出發才開始導航。

【上車前、上車後，都知道下一步】
在 App 內走到站牌，看看往這一站開來的車。上車後可確認實際車牌，查看沿途站牌、剩餘站數與下車時間預估。定位短暫不穩時保留行程進度，訊號恢復後接續更新；查看後面的路段，也不會改變正在進行的導航。

【YouBike，接上最後一段路】
走到捷運站太遠，或下車後還有一段路？規劃時一併比較適合的 YouBike 接駁。途中可點開借、還車站，查看目前可借車輛、可還空位與更新時間。數量以現場為準，App 不提供車輛或車位預約。

【免費功能】
路線規劃、導航、官方到站資訊、站牌收藏、YouBike 站點資訊與 3D 公車地圖，無需登入即可使用。支援系統深色模式與 English，英文站名同時保留中文。

【台北公車 Pro｜選用訂閱】
• 捷運列車動態與跟隨鏡頭
• 快到站時的下車通知與震動提醒
• 動態島與鎖定畫面的搭車資訊
• 常用行程桌面小工具與捷徑
• 個人路線偏好
免費版每天可試用 3 次列車動態或跟隨鏡頭。

月費 NT$39、年費 NT$390，兩種方案功能相同。符合資格的帳號可免費試用 7 天，之後依所選方案自動續訂。確認購買時由 Apple 帳號付款；除非在本期結束前至少 24 小時關閉自動續訂，否則會於本期結束前 24 小時內收取下一期費用。可在 App Store 帳號設定中管理或取消訂閱。
使用條款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
隱私政策：https://rio10255254.github.io/TaipeiBus/privacy.html

定位權限為選用，也能手動選擇出發地。開啟 Pro 背景搭車資訊或下車提醒時，導航會在背景使用定位；行程結束即停止。提醒方式依 iPhone 的通知與震動設定而定。

公車與 YouBike 資料來自臺北市公開資料服務，公車車程另參考交通部 TDX 站間資料，捷運資料來自臺北捷運公開資料。公車位置依車輛回報更新，捷運位置為推估，皆可能受資料更新頻率影響；到站與抵達時間不保證準點。地圖採用 MapLibre／OpenFreeMap（OpenStreetMap 資料），地點搜尋、步行與自行車路線由 Apple 地圖提供。服務範圍依收錄路線而定，YouBike 目前限臺北市。本 App 為獨立開發，並非政府、公車業者或臺北捷運官方 App。

promotionalText: 在 3D 地圖上看公車與捷運動態，一起比較公車、捷運、步行與 YouBike 接駁。從走到站牌到準備下車，每一步接著走。
reviewNotes:
VERSION 1.8.9. No login or sample files are required. Location is optional; departure can be chosen manually.

PURPOSE / AUDIENCE: Taipei commuters and visitors can compare public buses, metro, walking and YouBike connections, see official arrivals and vehicle map views, and follow the whole trip. Functionality is consistent across regions; download availability is Taiwan only. Bus/metro coverage follows the included Taipei network; YouBike covers Taipei City. Chinese and English can be selected in Information and settings.

REVIEW OUTSIDE TAIPEI: open destination search, set departure to 捷運市政府站 (Taipei City Hall MRT) and destination to 臺北車站 (Taipei Main Station). Wait for confirmed alternatives; tap a route and 步驟 (Steps) to preview without starting navigation. Tap 出發 (Go) / 開始導航 (Start Navigation) to begin. Official arrivals and vehicles depend on Taipei local operating hours.

FIRST PUBLIC PRO SUBMISSION: include both subscription versions and the group version. Group: TaipeiBus Pro. Products: com.rio10255254.TaipeiBus.pro.monthly (NT$39/month) and com.rio10255254.TaipeiBus.pro.yearly (NT$390/year). Both offer identical features and a seven-day free trial for eligible accounts. Open 資料來源與地圖設定 (Information and settings) > 台北公車 Pro > 查看 Pro 方案. The paywall displays prices, period, trial/renewal terms, Restore Purchases, Manage Subscription, Privacy Policy and Apple standard EULA. Verified StoreKit transactions determine access; no app account is needed.

Pro: estimated metro train positions and follow camera (three daily free uses); alighting notification/vibration; Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Live Activity; saved-trip widget, saved trips and route preferences. Planning, navigation, official arrivals, YouBike information and the 3D bus map remain free. Bike rental/payment is outside this app, with no rental charge or YouBike login collected here.

BACKGROUND LOCATION: used only during an active Pro navigation with Live Activity or alighting reminders enabled, to update progress/reminders while locked. The system location indicator is shown; updates stop when the trip ends. Both features can be disabled in Pro settings. Passenger location is processed locally and is not sent to a developer server. Apple Maps receives route endpoints/search queries as needed for directions and place search.

EXTERNAL SERVICES: Taipei City public bus GPS/arrival feeds; Taipei City YouBike open station/bike/dock data; TDX official station-to-station travel-time profiles (cached data-only catalog, no keys in the app); Taipei Metro public platform-arrival reports. Bus positions follow provider GPS reports. Metro positions are labelled ESTIMATES from platform reports/schedules, not train GPS. Arrival times and station availability are reports/estimates, not guarantees or reservations. MapLibre / OpenFreeMap with OpenStreetMap attribution supplies the map. Apple MapKit supplies place search, walking and cycling directions. StoreKit handles purchases. Live Activities update locally without a push server; widgets read locally saved trips and public arrivals. No account creation, UGC, ads, AI service or tracking. Open-data notices/source links are in Information and settings. This is an independent information app, not an official government app or transport operator.

1.8.9 preserves confirmed progress through short GPS gaps, separates future-leg previews from current navigation, and unifies remaining-time display. Empty results retain a retry and Other transport action instead of a blank sheet. The submitted build enables no synthetic vehicle fixtures. Remote JSON updates bounded settings/existing strings only; no executable code is downloaded.
whatsNew:
1.8.9，讓整趟行程接得更順。

• 一起比較公車、捷運與 YouBike 接駁，納入步行、候車和借還車時間。
• YouBike 借還車站可直接點開，查看目前車輛與空位。
• 改善校園等地點的步行接駁，減少搜尋後無法計算路線的情況。
• 定位短暫變弱時保留行程進度，上車後可用手機定位接續追蹤。
• 查看後續路段時，當前導航繼續進行；剩餘時間與抵達估計的顯示更一致。
• 改善路線比較、地圖呈現與中英文資訊的閱讀；沒有可用方案時提供清楚的下一步。

也帶來捷運列車動態與選用 Pro：動態島、鎖定畫面搭車資訊、下車提醒、小工具、跟隨鏡頭與常用行程。月費 NT$39、年費 NT$390，符合資格者可免費試用 7 天。
